refuter_findings.evidence: The current Definition introduces each fixed-degree group H_j, then says “The ring R_T acts by pullback from B_K and cap product” and defines fractions only for a generic R_T-module M. Its cited supplier defines H_j degree by degree, while the torus supplier gives |u_i|=2; cap by u_i maps H_j to H_{j-2}, not back to H_j. The current Definition does not specify the total graded module or a graded localization with degree pieces. The routed historical reader:50:1 observation names this producer; the current Definition and its proof still do not supply that missing grading convention.

The Definition uses S_T^{-1}H_j(F), S_T^{-1}H_j(X), and S_T^{-1}H_j(pt) in its map and inverse. The localized Borel–Moore definition supplies no R_T-module structure on each fixed-degree H_j: its degree-two cap classes shift H_j to H_{j-2}. Thus these source and target modules, and the stated inverse between them, are not defined as written.

The step places 1/(u_1u_2) in S_T^{-1}H_4^{BM,T}(pt). The Borel–Moore supplier defines H_j^{BM,T}(pt) as the degree -j equivariant group over BT, so H_4^{BM,T}(pt)=H^{-4}(BT)=0. Degreewise localization is undefined here; if interpreted as localization of the zero group, it cannot contain 1/(u_1u_2). That fraction belongs in a degree-four piece of a localization of the total graded group, which is not the target stated.

The step applies the localized pushforward theorem to obtain 1/u. But that theorem states its target as S_T^{-1}H_2^{BM,T}(pt), and the Borel–Moore supplier gives H_2^{BM,T}(pt)=H^{-2}(BT)=0. The claimed output requires a degree-two piece of a graded total localization; the current theorem and pushforward definition do not define that target.

The displayed isomorphism is between S_T^{-1}H_j^{BM,T}(F) and S_T^{-1}H_j^{BM,T}(X) for every fixed j. The Borel–Moore supplier defines these as fixed-degree groups, and the degree-two coefficient classes act by shifting H_j to H_{j-2}; hence they are not R_T-modules to which the stated fraction localization applies. The exactness of localization for modules does not define these groups or this isomorphism.

The formula is stated to lie in S_T^{-1}H_{2d-q}^{BM,T}(pt), and its localized pushforward is defined using fixed-degree localized groups. The cited Borel–Moore convention has degree-two cap classes shifting H_j to H_{j-2}; no module structure on each H_j or graded degree-piece localization is supplied. Thus the stated map and target are not defined as written.
